name: Monthly hosted field card discovery
description: 1st of the month 17:00: research the SDLC life cycle and decide update or no-change. Credit: judge the account picture. Story and Bayes: judge picker/jobs. Stamp all four. Not stamp-only.

prompts.prompt:
AUTOMATION_CONTRACT

Before other steps: read `.state/AUTOMATION_CONTRACT.md`. Do not use ProjectBrain MCP.

Monthly discovery of Orbit-hosted field cards for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/Orbit (branch main).
Follow docs/architecture/field-card-review.md section “Monthly hosted cards”. That section is the procedure if this prompt is shorter.

Public cadence is monthly. Do not write “week of” or “Weekly review” on the cards. Research the SDLC life cycle, then judge. Not a stamp-only bump.

Cards (Orbit paths, not source repos):
- public/sdlc-field-card/index.html — H1 “Build software that stays in use”; pillars Plan & design → Build & verify → Release & deploy → Maintain & improve; read PLAYBOOK.md including “Monthly research” and keep its three lines (plan fits on a page a person will review; a spec file is not shared understanding; a person drops tests that do not fail for the right reason); job table still a written plan, threat-in-design, security checks in verify, a verified build, a release people run, and continuous improvement from use, plus a fix through the same four pillars; calendars, proof, and cutover stay on Delivery; this card owns release, deploy, maintain, and improve of the software; do not add an AI-native brochure (intent files, continuous evals, REVIEW.md)
- public/credit-risk-field-card/index.html — H1 “Credit risk is for a lifetime. Act early.”; spine ORIGINATE → MONITOR → STAGE → PROVISION; read PLAYBOOK.md; the picture is the job (one account, 12-month ECL in stage 1, lifetime ECL from stage 2 including a credit-impaired stage 3); do not restore a problem/use/example table, picker, or ladder
- public/story-field-card/index.html — Hub competency Story; H1 “Turn evidence into a decision”; operating chain Question → Evidence → Tension → Narrative → Experience → Decision; craft DWELL → CLAIM → SKETCH → LEAD → OPEN; read PLAYBOOK.md; essays stay prose; grain stays on Analytics
- public/bayes-field-card/index.html — method card, not Hub; H1 “Bayesian optimisation is a budget of trials, not a search of space”; spine BOUND → MODEL → ACQ → STOP; read PLAYBOOK.md; not a BoTorch brochure

Steps:
1. Prefer open branch chore/monthly-field-cards-YYYY-MM for this calendar month; else create it from main.
2. SDLC research (required, once this month): follow public/sdlc-field-card/PLAYBOOK.md section “Monthly research”. Open real sources on plan and design, build and verify, release and deploy, and maintain and improve, including security in that order. Then assess whether the picker or job table should change. Credit: read public/credit-risk-field-card/PLAYBOOK.md and judge the account picture. Do not restore a table. Story and Bayes: read PLAYBOOK.md and judge picker and jobs against the spine. Do not convert Story, Bayes, or SDLC into a scene in this run. Do not invent docs URLs.
3. If a card should change, edit the HTML. If not, leave the picture or the picker as-is. SDLC no-change is allowed only after the research note exists.
4. Always bump #version-stamp to Reviewed <this month> · Next: <next month>. Credit’s Changed line: “Monthly review — the account picture unchanged” unless the picture’s HTML changed. Other hosted cards: “Monthly review — picker and jobs unchanged” unless you actually changed that card’s HTML.
5. Do not edit the three source-repo cards (AI / analytics / delivery) except to keep inbound Bayes links if they already exist.
6. Do not add a Hub competency tile for Bayesian optimisation. Do not register FIELD_CARDS.
7. Commit/push to the monthly PR only. Write ## Summary with Decision: update|no-change per card. For SDLC also list the URLs you opened and one sentence on why the card did or did not change. For Credit list the Inside the fence links you opened. “Did not look” is not a decision.
8. Stop. Do not merge. Do not Slack-Approve.

Done when SDLC was researched, every hosted card was judged and stamped for this month, and the PR is open.
